title: Figure 4.1: Cross Section of the Experimental Layout of the PFX-I Experiment
description: Line schematic cross-section of the PFX-I Penning-type IEC experiment showing an 'Onion-shaped conductor' at 0 V, an 'e emitter' at -W0 kV, a 'Reflector' at '-W0 kV - few V', and a 'Superconducting magnet' with z and ρ axes marked. The caption explains the emitter-electron source, onion-shaped anode and reflector form an axial electrostatic well for electron axial confinement, with radial confinement provided by the axial magnetic field.
